parsed.explanation: Traveller-facing exposures are thin but real. Discrimination in accommodation and hate speech remain lawful, with no local statutory remedy, so a refused visitor has no recourse (tier 3). Police avoidance by LGBTQ people signals that reporting is unreliable. Official framing is hostile, though dated: the 2005 port exclusion was ad hoc and the 2011 'no mandate' statement predates the 2022 ruling. There is no trans-specific criminal offence, no documented facility or border rule, no documented targeting, and no trans-specific violence data. Legal gender recognition and same-sex unions are resident-facing and weigh little. Extrapolating from the lawful service discrimination with no remedy and unreliable police, the rating sits in the elevated band, below neutral but well above high risk.
